title: 火球与高能冲击脉冲

source.prompt: TrackType: SFX. TrackType: Sound Effect, VocalType: Instrumental. Original isolated retro fantasy tactical game sound effect, crisp and restrained, mobile-speaker-friendly midrange, no copied recording. No music, no melody, no speech, no singing, no choir, no background ambience. One short stylized fiery energy puff, a quick warm filtered-noise flare with a compact crackling edge, clean rapid decay, retro tactical game effect. Single pulse only, designed for animation-controlled repeated requests, not a sustained fire ambience. Single isolated one-shot, immediate attack and natural decay within 0.32 seconds. Then silence. No second event, no repeated sequence, no music or voice.
source.negative_prompt: music, melody, rhythm loop, vocals, speech, singing, choir, crowd, harsh distortion, clipping, long reverb, background noise, cinematic trailer

editing.method: first meaningful onset, first transient, natural-decay search, bounded envelope tail

mastering.method: constant active-RMS gain with category peak ceiling

transient_shaping.method: smooth tanh soft knee only above 40 percent of source peak
transient_shaping.reason: excessive transient crest made useful event energy too quiet under original peak budget

mastering.active_rms_comparison_method: 220-sample (approximately 5ms) stereo RMS windows; active=max(0.03*max_window_rms,-55dBFS), matching source baseline
mastering.basis: Preserve original relative levels: UI not louder in active RMS; ordinary impacts at most +2dB and magic +1dB; sustained textures capped at -23dBFS active RMS.

auditory_review_note: Objective signal/timing checks only; sound identity, absence of speech/music and subjective fatigue need listening.
